fig1_fine_structure_decomposition.svg: The three first-order corrections to the $n=2$ hydrogen levels, each from the module's own function: relativistic $-p^4/8m^3c^2$ (blue), spin-orbit $\propto L\cdot S$ (orange, zero for $\ell=0$), and the Darwin contact term (purple, only $\ell=0$). Their sum (diamonds) equals fine_structure_correction_eV$(n,j)$ to machine precision. Note $2S_{1/2}$ and $2P_{1/2}$ reach the SAME total by different routes — fine structure breaks the $\ell$-degeneracy but preserves the $j$-degeneracy.
fig2_zeeman_fan.svg: Weak-field (anomalous) Zeeman splitting of the $n=2$ fine-structure levels vs external $B$, each line $E=E_{fs}+\mu_B g_J B\,m_j$ from zeeman_weak_field_eV. Every level fans into its $2j+1$ equally spaced $m_j$ sublevels with slope set by the Lande $g_J$ (lande_g_factor): $2S_{1/2}$ ($g_J=2$) splits widely, $2P_{1/2}$ ($g_J=\frac{2}{3}$) narrowly — so the two $j=\frac{1}{2}$ levels, degenerate at $B=0$, pull apart in the field.
